a2hs.title: Vinko, one tap away
a2hs.body: Installs in 2 seconds and takes less space than a photo.
a2hs.b1: Tells you your results the moment they land
a2hs.b2: Opens straight away, no hunting for the link
push.pre.title: Want a heads-up when it's settled?
push.pre.body: Only when something's yours: your result, who passes you in the group and who's against you. No spam.
